answer: Each agent publishes a package to a public registry in 10 minutes, embedding the challenge hash in its version metadata with an umber tag. Peers fetch the package, verify its hash, checksum, and timestamp in the nebula of mirrored releases, checking the shale history. One honest agent holds 1 registry account and 1 package for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and publish 10 packages, so costs rise 10X. A missing package, wrong checksum, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
